page.notes: Numbers 10 to 60 stand in the gutter between the two printed pages, at intervals of ten lines; they are placed on the lines where they appear and belong to the left column. The first line of the left column, the "Geneuensis" line break, and the "Dauidem" line are uncertain. "Vas-/cosanum" was read as Vascosanum, which is uncertain. "phyficę" in the Caballi entry, "Cosctus" for Coscius, "Cremesis", and "Oppaviani" are doubtful readings. "Eiuf/dé" and "Pe-/treius" line breaks may hide hyphens. The right-page number 181 is uncertain: it looks like 181 but could be read differently. Long s, u/v and i/j have been normalised as instructed. Line-initial asterisks are printed marks.
